description: Replace the agent's settings and return the updated entry. Known limitation: this is a FULL REPLACEMENT, not a patch - every field you omit is reset, so read the current settings with mba_get_agent_settings first and send them back with your change applied. Note also that setting rollout.enabled to false stops the AI responding on all threads; re-enabling it makes the AI respond to new threads only, not to threads that were already open.

agent_id.description: Optional - restrict the update to one agent.

ai_audience.description: ALLOWLISTED_ONLY restricts the agent to the numbers on the allowlist.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

followup.description: Following up with an inactive user.

handoff.description: Handing the conversation to a human agent.

rollout.description: Whether the agent responds at all. Disabling it stops the AI answering on every thread.

name: mba_update_agent_settings
title: Update agent settings
